question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Synthetic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option(4) i.e. Natural**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Synthetic"** means something that is made by chemical synthesis, especially to imitate a natural product. (कृत्रिम)

 
 
• **Example: **He prefers synthetic fabrics over natural ones because they are easier to maintain.
 
 
 
• **"Natural" **refers to something that exists in or is derived from nature; not made or caused by humankind. (प्राकृतिक)
 
 
• **Example: **She loves using natural ingredients in her recipes for their authentic flavors.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'synthetic' **is **'natural'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option(5) i.e. Natural**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Artificial **(कृत्रिम): Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally.

 
 
• **Example:** The artificial flowers looked so real that it was hard to tell the difference.
 
 
 
• **Imitation **(नकली): Something produced as a copy of something else.
 
 
• **Example: **The necklace she wore was an imitation of a famous designer piece.
 
 
 
• **Processed** (प्रसंस्कृत): Having been subjected to a special treatment or procedure.
 
 
• **Example:** Processed foods often contain additives and preservatives.
